subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): scope memory_recall and memory_forget + configurable thresholds

question: Should memory-lancedb accept this explicit `[SCOPE:<slug>]` plus tool-parameter partition contract and new recall-threshold config now, or should scoped isolation wait for the per-agent/per-channel design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102973?
rationale: The diff adds durable plugin API, setup-visible config, and persisted LanceDB columns; automation can review mechanics, but maintainers need to choose the long-term product contract for memory partitioning.

options.title: Continue With This Foundation
options.body: Proceed with this PR direction after requiring rebase, docs, real LanceDB upgrade proof, and focused review of the remaining ambient-scoping boundary.

options.title: Defer To Ambient Scoping Design
options.body: Pause or close this PR until the per-agent/per-channel autoCapture and autoRecall configuration shape is decided in the linked issue.

options.title: Narrow To Threshold Config Only
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that only exposes the recall thresholds while scoping semantics are redesigned separately.

recommendation.title: Continue With This Foundation
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR direction after requiring rebase, docs, real LanceDB upgrade proof, and focused review of the remaining ambient-scoping boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is product/API direction for a high-impact plugin surface, and `steipete` has the strongest current-history signal across the memory-lancedb files plus broad recent ownership.
